metricVisualCorrelation.interpretation: Mean and P95 gains separate many no-difference comparisons from large changes, but they do not separate visually beneficial large changes from visually regressive large changes.

calibrationValidation.method: Logical-case split fixed before review. Candidate thresholds are exhaustively selected from observed calibration metric values, minimizing false-small plus false-large errors; ties prefer fewer false-small errors.
calibrationValidation.warning: This is an analysis-only separability probe, not an approved recommendation tolerance. It is calibrated to model visual judgments and cannot replace independent human validation.

relativeTo221Guard.reason: No mean/P95 tolerance has independent human support, and large metric improvements occur in both visually beneficial and visually regressive comparisons.

qualityPlateau.reason: Visible quality is not monotonic with profile size in the controlled review, so an earliest stable plateau cannot be inferred reliably from profile order alone.

combinedRelativeAndAdjacentSafeguard.reason: The adjacent metric safeguard cannot distinguish beneficial changes from regressions; the illustrative calibration rule produced 9 errors in 45 held-out comparisons.

decision: GENERATION RECOMMENDATION EVIDENCE INSUFFICIENT — MORE EVALUATION REQUIRED
